name: web-basic
description: A web app that runs in the browser: React + TypeScript + Vite, tested with Vitest. Data is kept in the browser.
notes: About the starter app (no need to read these files):
- src/App.tsx shows the app's name in an <h1>. As the app grows it only lays out the screens and puts the areas together; it holds no logic of its own. src/main.tsx mounts it; leave that as it is.

- Organise the code so it stays easy to change as it grows: one folder per area of the app in src/features/<area>/ (for example plants, settings), with that area's components, logic and tests. Other code uses an area only through its src/features/<area>/index.ts. Shared small pieces go in src/ui/.
- Saved data is read and written only through src/data/ (storage.ts has load and save). Keep old saved data readable when its shape changes.
- The save gate blocks files over 200 lines, saved data handled outside src/data/, and one area reaching inside another. Write small files from the start.
- src/App.test.tsx has one test, 'the app opens'. Keep it. Put each area's tests next to its code, e.g. src/features/plants/plants.test.tsx.

- Tests use Vitest with test and expect available everywhere, plus Testing Library: import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react' and userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'. Each test starts with an empty localStorage and a clean page.
- There is no CSS file yet: add src/App.css and import it in App.tsx, or give an area its own CSS file.
